He is the announcer of [[Pokémon Showcase]]s. ==History== [[File:Aria and Pierre.png|thumb|left|250px|Pierre and Aria at the dance party]] Pierre debuted in ''[[XY047|Dreaming a Performer's Dream!]]'', where he was seen calling {{an|Aria}} on stage to give an exhibition performance at the [[Lagoon Town]] [[Pokémon Showcase]] Rookie Class. He appeared in {{an|Serena}}'s dream in ''[[XY058|The Green, Green Grass Types of Home!]]''. In ''[[XY064|Battling with Elegance and a Big Smile!]]'', Pierre was seen in a [[Pokévision]] video recapping {{an|Shauna}}'s victory at the {{ci|Coumarine}} Showcase. In ''[[XY075|Rivals: Today and Tomorrow!]]'', Pierre appeared on [[television]] to announce an upcoming Pokémon Showcase in [[Dendemille Town]]. In ''[[XY089|A Frolicking Find in the Flowers!]]'', Pierre appeared in Serena's guidebook video to announce that an upcoming Pokémon Showcase would be located in [[Anistar City]]. In ''[[XY105|Party Dancecapades!]]'', Pierre hosted a party for Performers and their Pokémon which included {{wp|Ballroom dance|ballroom dancing}} followed by a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]]. He was Aria's dance partner. At the end of the party, he announced a Pokémon Showcase was slated to be held in [[Fleurrh City]]. In ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'', he hosted the [[Fleurrh City]] Pokémon Showcase. Near the end of the episode, he announced [[Gloire City]] as the location of the Pokémon Showcase Master Class. ==Character== Pierre speaks with a French accent and has a tendency of interspersing French phrases with his regular speech, such as "{{tt|s'il vous plaît|please}}". At the start of a Pokémon Showcase, he announces the theme of the competition. He is also the one to introduce the [[Pokémon Performer]]s on stage and to explain the proceedings to the audience. Furthermore, he keeps track of the time the Performers are given during the Theme Performance and hands out the Princess Key to the winner. He has high enthusiasm for his job. His trademark item is his staff, which his {{p|Klefki}} sits on top of. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Monsieur Pierre's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Monsieur Pierre |pkmn=Klefki |gender=male |type1=Steel |type2=Fairy |img=Monsieur Pierre Klefki.png |epnum=XY047 |epname=Dreaming a Performer's Dream! |vajp=Yūji Ueda |vaen=Suzy Myers |desc={{p|Klefki}} is Monsieur Pierre's only known Pokémon. He first appeared in ''[[XY047|Dreaming a Performer's Dream!]]''. He was only shown sitting on top of Monsieur Pierre's staff. He appeared again in ''[[XY060|A Showcase Debut!]]'' at the [[Coumarine City]] [[Pokémon Showcase]]. He presented the {{DL|Pokémon Showcase|Princess Key}} to the audience. Klefki appeared again in ''[[XY105|Party Dancecapades!]]'', where he was seen dancing with [[Aria's Delphox]] in a dance party hosted by his Trainer.
